verdict.rationale: Mastercard publishes an OpenAPI specification that generates a client library, which gives documented machine-readable schemas (gh-1). Its docs describe the account and transaction data elements returned for each account-type data segment. For enrichment, it offers transaction insights (transaction types, recurring transactions, consumer spending, loan payments) and confidence scores for account-ownership matching, so automated workflows can work with structured outputs rather than raw strings. missing for 10: explicit evidence of JSON response format and field-level schema examples, detail on how enrichment fields such as categories are structured, independent or hands-on corroboration that responses are clean and consistent across institutions.
